items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...the piano player is Hank Duncan... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I wasn't in that band.

ctx.x: Wilber...Bob Wilber...? Bob Wilber was playing clarinet instead of playing soprano. We did a lot of rehearsing on Christie Street and way down over there, you know...

Well, you made a number of other recordings with Bechet. There's also what seems to me here a broadcast, an aircheck, which was put out, recorded in May and June of 1945 at the Savoy Cafe in Boston. There weren't any tunes listed. But it's Sidney Bechet and His New Orleans Rhythm Kings. That's the way apparently it's billed. Pops Foster is playing, the piano player is Hank Duncan, and apparently they're not sure whether the drummer is you or a fellow by the name of George Thompson. Do you remember playing Boston…
